Instructions for Use
Device description: The Fjord Peripheral Stent is a peripheral stent. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
The Fjord Peripheral Stent is MR Conditional. A person with the Fjord Peripheral Stent may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Fjord Peripheral Stent
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 and 3 Tesla
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 19 T/m (1,900 gauss/cm)
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 100 T/m/s per axis
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 1 W/kg
Scan Duration No more than 60 minutes of active scan time per session.
